method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the equality relation on closed terms, replay of all five congruence and substitutivity clauses, quotient term-model definition, representative-independence proof, factored evaluation lemma and equality case of the Truth Lemma, followed by exact formula, macro, controlled-token, label, identifier and reference comparison after two documented source projections. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Identity in the completeness construction: quotienting the term model by the equality relation induced by Gamma-star and restoring the Truth Lemma for sentences containing equality.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The ordinary term model cannot satisfy a Gamma-star equality between syntactically distinct terms because each term evaluates to itself. Define t approximately t-prime exactly when their equality sentence belongs to the complete consistent set, preparing a quotient construction.
samples.checks: The equality-free limitation, values of t and t-prime, false equality, language L, closed-term carrier and defining membership biconditional are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The induced relation is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, is respected by each function argument, and preserves predicate membership. Complete consistency reduces these claims to the five corresponding derivability properties, which the exercise asks readers to prove.
samples.checks: Every index, omitted i-th argument, function and predicate clause, equality direction and derivability formula is retained. OLCOM-004 removes only one duplicated comma in a function term.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Form equivalence classes of closed terms and define the quotient structure by classes of constants and function terms and by predicate truth in the original term model. The congruence proposition ensures that functions and predicates do not depend on chosen representatives, proved by induction over the arguments.
samples.checks: Class notation, quotient carrier, all four interpretation clauses, representative equality and both well-definedness conclusions preserve every formula. OLCOM-005 restores t-prime in the proposed failing predicate instance.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Before the Truth Lemma, the value of every closed term in the quotient model is shown to be its equivalence class, by the same induction as in the original term model; an exercise requests the full proof.
samples.checks: The model identity, value equation, cross-reference and exercise reference are unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The quotient model satisfies every sentence exactly when it belongs to Gamma-star. All earlier induction cases transfer; for equality, satisfaction is class equality, which is equivalent to the induced relation and hence to equality-sentence membership.
samples.checks: The all-sentences scope, structural induction, identity case and all three displayed biconditionals are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Although the original term model is enumerable and infinite, its quotient can be finite because many terms may share classes; a consistent universal equality sentence forces a one-element domain.
samples.checks: Enumerability, infinitude, finite quotient, universal formula, consistency and exactly-one-element conclusion are retained.

source_observations: OLCOM-004 records a duplicated comma inside the first function term of the fourth derivability clause; the target removes it and QA projects it back for frozen-source comparison.

OLCOM-005 records that the representative-independence counterexample repeats R(t) where the second representative requires R(t-prime); the target restores t-prime and QA projects it back for comparison.
All remaining formulas, macros, controlled tokens, tags, labels, identifiers and reference options match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The established quotient vocabulary भागाकारसंच, तुल्यतावर्ग, प्रतिनिधी and सुव्याख्यायित remains open to expert stylistic review in this model-theoretic setting.
The congruence and factored-value proofs requested as exercises are not supplied.
